page.content:
Soviet dictator whose armies broke the Wehrmacht in the east.

How Joseph Stalin connects

  • Faction: Allies — Stalin's Soviet Union was the eastern pillar of the Alliance.
  • Event: Operation Barbarossa — Stalin's state absorbed and then reversed Barbarossa.
  • Event: Yalta Conference — Stalin bargained occupation and the UN at Yalta.

What is Joseph Stalin?

Joseph Stalin absorbed the 1941 invasion, relocated industry, and drove the Red Army to Berlin. His later occupation of Eastern Europe was the other face of that victory.

Key threads lead to Allies, Operation Barbarossa and Yalta Conference.
